nodes.title: Prompt Registry
nodes.summary: Keep production prompts in an immutable, version-controlled registry with schemas, ownership, and rollback revisions. This makes deployed behavior reproducible and recoverable.
nodes.probe: Parse the production prompt manifest; for every referenced prompt assert nonempty immutable id, semantic or monotonically increasing version, committed source path, parameter schema, owner, content digest, and rollback_version that exists. Fail on duplicate IDs, uncommitted paths, or a mutable alias used as the deployed reference.

nodes.title: Prompt Release Metadata
nodes.summary: Attach provider, model, prompt, tool, decoding, safety, and evaluation revisions to every LLM release. Complete metadata enables incident reproduction and attribution.
nodes.probe: Parse each LLM deployment manifest and assert provider, model, prompt_version, tool/system prompt digests, decoding parameters, safety policy, and evaluation dataset revision are present and non-defaulted where required. Build a candidate artifact with one field removed and verify the release gate exits nonzero.

nodes.title: Prompt Regression Suite
nodes.summary: Run repeatable task, safety, schema, and quality evaluations whenever prompts, tools, models, or decoding change. Baseline comparisons expose regressions before promotion.
nodes.probe: Invoke the repository evaluator for the changed prompt set with a fixed dataset revision; compare candidate metrics to the baseline and exit nonzero if any required task, safety, groundedness, or schema metric falls below its checked-in threshold. Verify the report identifies failed fixture IDs.

nodes.title: Golden Dataset Versioning
nodes.summary: Maintain a versioned, consented evaluation corpus with provenance, rubrics, and representative risk cohorts. Adversarial and long-tail coverage prevents misleading happy-path results.
nodes.probe: Parse the dataset manifest and fail when any example lacks stable id, revision, provenance/license or consent, rubric/label, or cohort. Check that holdout IDs do not overlap tuning IDs and that required adversarial, multilingual, long-context, and long-tail cohorts have nonzero counts.

nodes.title: CI Evaluation Gate
nodes.summary: Make quality, safety, groundedness, schema, latency, and cost thresholds enforceable promotion gates. Deployment must fail closed when a candidate breaches reviewed limits.
nodes.probe: Parse CI workflow files and assert a required evaluation job consumes the candidate, compares against a baseline, and exits nonzero on threshold failure. Run a deliberately degraded fixture or threshold in a temporary branch and verify the deployment job is blocked.

nodes.title: Human Sampling
nodes.summary: Sample production traces by risk, cohort, model, and confidence for blinded human adjudication. Feed privacy-aware labels and disagreements back into versioned evaluation data.
nodes.probe: Evidence assessor inspects the sampling policy, consent/privacy controls, blinded reviewer workflow, stratified sample reports, inter-reviewer agreement, adjudication records, and examples showing labels feed a versioned evaluation set. Confirm high-risk cohorts are not excluded and reviewer access is audited.

nodes.title: Model Routing Policy
nodes.summary: Route requests using explicit capability, context, latency, residency, availability, and cost requirements. Explainable ordered policy avoids incompatible or unnecessarily expensive model choices.
nodes.probe: Parse router policy and model catalog; for every production route assert ordered predicates, supported capabilities, maximum context, owner, region/residency, and cost/latency metadata. Run fixtures varying context, residency, capability, and budget and verify the selected route is the first compliant one or a safe no-route error.

nodes.title: Provider Fallback Chain
nodes.summary: Use a bounded, compatibility-tested chain of provider or model alternatives for retryable failures while preserving safety, residency, schema, and output semantics. Exhaustion ends in a safe terminal error.
nodes.probe: Load the fallback policy and use a stub provider harness to inject 429, timeout, and 5xx responses. Assert ordered compatible fallback, bounded attempts and wall-clock deadline, preserved schema/safety/residency settings, and a safe terminal error after exhaustion; inject a non-retryable 4xx and assert no fallback.

nodes.title: Circuit Breaker and Retry
nodes.summary: Protect provider calls with deadlines, jittered exponential backoff, retry budgets, and closed/open/half-open circuit states. This limits outage amplification and duplicate billable or side-effecting work.
nodes.probe: Parse retry and breaker settings, then inject repeated 429/5xx responses with timestamps. Assert delays are bounded and jittered, total attempts and wall time stay within budget, the breaker opens and rejects calls, half-open probes are limited, and no attempt occurs after the request deadline.

nodes.title: Token Budget Enforcement
nodes.summary: Enforce deterministic input, output, combined, and tenant token limits before upstream calls. Explicit truncation, summarization, downgrade, queue, or rejection policy controls spend and latency.
nodes.probe: Read gateway limits and issue fixtures just below, exactly at, and above input, output, and combined caps. Assert deterministic truncation or rejection occurs before an upstream call, tenant quota is enforced, and the recorded token count matches the selected tokenizer.

nodes.title: Cost Accounting
nodes.summary: Attribute every billable attempt to tokens, pricing, retries, cache outcome, tenant, feature, and prompt revision. Reconcile application records with provider usage to explain invoices and regressions.
nodes.probe: Send a tagged canary request that exercises a cache hit/miss and a retry; query its trace/export and assert input/output token directions, pricing revision, tenant, feature, prompt version, and attempt count are present. Compare a period aggregate with the provider usage report and fail if variance exceeds the documented tolerance.

nodes.title: Budget Alerts
nodes.summary: Turn spend and capacity budgets into warning alerts and hard-stop admission controls with accountable responders. Limits cover money, tokens, volume, retries, and queue depth over explicit windows.
nodes.probe: Parse budget and alert configuration; replay usage across warning and hard-stop thresholds. Assert an owner notification at warning, request blocking/downgrade before upstream invocation at hard stop, correct Retry-After/typed error, and alert recovery after the window resets.

nodes.title: Latency SLO
nodes.summary: Define journey- and model-tier-specific budgets for queueing, retrieval, TTFT, completion, fallback, and end-to-end latency. Percentile targets and propagated deadlines make slow eventual success visible.
nodes.probe: Parse SLO configuration and metric names; assert every production journey/tier has TTFT and end-to-end percentile targets plus queue/retrieval/deadline budgets. Run timed streaming and non-streaming fixtures and verify recorded timestamps and that injected delay causes the configured deadline/error-budget failure.

nodes.title: Streaming Backpressure
nodes.summary: Bound streaming buffers and propagate client cancellation through provider, worker, retrieval, and tools. A documented non-streaming fallback prevents abandoned work and memory exhaustion.
nodes.probe: Open a streaming request, consume partial output, then disconnect; assert the upstream call receives cancellation, worker/buffer counts return to baseline, no orphan tool continues, and a non-streaming request remains usable. Hold a client below producer speed and assert queue memory stays under its configured bound.

nodes.title: Response Cache Safety
nodes.summary: Cache only deterministic or explicitly safe responses under keys scoped to identity, policy, prompt/model, and knowledge state. Bounded TTL and revision invalidation prevent disclosure and stale behavior.
nodes.probe: Inspect key construction and run identical-input fixtures across two tenants, auth scopes, prompt/model revisions, safety policies, and knowledge revisions. Assert isolated results, misses after each revision, no cache write for side-effecting/sensitive cases, and bounded TTL expiry.

nodes.title: Request Deduplication
nodes.summary: Coalesce concurrent identical, side-effect-free requests under scoped idempotency keys and return one shared result. Mismatches and external side effects must conflict or bypass coalescing.
nodes.probe: Fire N concurrent requests with the same key and identical fingerprint against a provider stub; assert exactly one provider call and identical shared result. Repeat with mismatched payload, tenant, prompt revision, and a side-effecting tool; assert conflict or bypass and verify lease recovery.

nodes.title: Input Guardrails
nodes.summary: Validate size, type, prohibited content, prompt injection, and trust boundaries before model or tool execution. Treat imported and user-controlled text as untrusted data.
nodes.probe: Run a versioned malicious-input corpus containing direct/indirect injection, oversized content, obfuscation, secrets, and disallowed material through the pre-call guardrail. Assert prohibited cases cause block/sanitize/quarantine with no provider or tool call, while allowed fixtures preserve required content and audit reason codes.

nodes.title: Output Guardrails
nodes.summary: Validate completions against schemas, safety policy, citation contracts, and allowed actions before returning or executing them. Bounded repair and typed refusal handling prevent unsafe downstream effects.
nodes.probe: Feed valid, malformed, unsafe, refusal, truncated, citation-invalid, and unauthorized-tool fixtures to the post-call validator. Assert valid results pass, unsafe or unauthorized results are rejected before downstream execution, repair attempts never exceed the configured count, and unrecoverable outputs produce a typed safe response.

nodes.title: Jailbreak Red Team
nodes.summary: Continuously test the full LLM application against injection, tool abuse, exfiltration, obfuscation, and refusal bypass. Findings require triage, regression coverage, remediation, and retesting.
nodes.probe: Evidence assessor inspects the current attack corpus, last scheduled exercise, coverage across direct/indirect injection, tools, exfiltration, multilingual and multi-turn cases, isolated test setup, severity triage, regression additions, and remediation/retest records. Confirm a failed high-severity attack blocks release or has an approved risk decision.

nodes.title: PII Redaction
nodes.summary: Detect and remove or minimize personal data, credentials, and secrets before persistence, provider transfer, evaluation storage, or telemetry emission. Layered detection and fail-closed high-risk handling reduce breach paths.
nodes.probe: Run a DLP/PII fixture corpus containing names, contacts, identifiers, credentials, secrets, and obfuscated forms through ingress, prompt assembly, completion, logs, traces, datasets, and exports. Assert exact sensitive values are absent before storage or outbound provider requests, placeholders preserve required structure, and detector failure blocks high-risk transfer.

nodes.title: LLM Tracing
nodes.summary: Emit correlated privacy-safe spans for orchestration, retrieval, model calls, tools, guardrails, and streaming. Record bounded metadata for debugging and cost attribution without broadly exposing raw model I/O.
nodes.probe: Send a canary request with retrieval, guardrail, and a stub tool; query its trace by correlation ID and assert all required parent/child spans and fields exist, timing is coherent, provider/model and prompt revision are present, and raw payload policy is honored. Verify an error trace retains the failure class without sensitive content.

nodes.title: Sensitive Trace Access
nodes.summary: Keep raw prompts, completions, attachments, and tool payloads encrypted and least-privileged with redacted defaults, retention/deletion enforcement, and audited exceptional access.
nodes.probe: Parse telemetry ACL, encryption, retention, export, and deletion configuration; run access tests for unauthorized, ordinary operator, and approved incident roles. Assert unauthorized roles cannot retrieve raw content, approved access is audited with justification, retention deletes fixtures, and deletion removes both primary and indexed copies.

nodes.title: Feedback Capture
nodes.summary: Capture consented ratings, corrections, overrides, and reviewer labels with exact behavior join keys. Rate limits, deduplication, and opt-out deletion keep feedback useful and privacy-aware.
nodes.probe: Submit positive, negative, correction, reviewer, duplicate, and opt-out fixtures; assert required join keys and consent state, rate limits and deduplication, deletion behavior, and exclusion of opted-out content from training/evaluation exports.

nodes.title: RAG Index Freshness
nodes.summary: Measure source-to-index lag, failed ingestion, ACL propagation, and deletion tombstones. Freshness and access-aware canaries prevent stale or unauthorized retrieval.
nodes.probe: Update and delete a canary source record, then compare source updated_at/deletion manifest with index watermark, retrievability, ACL state, and tombstone status. Assert each reaches the configured SLO, failed jobs/dead letters alert, and deleted or unauthorized content is not retrievable during and after propagation.

nodes.title: RAG Retrieval Evaluation
nodes.summary: Evaluate chunking, embeddings, filters, top-k, reranking, and context packing on labeled cohorts. Retrieval correctness includes relevance, latency, token impact, ACL enforcement, and deletion behavior.
nodes.probe: Run the retrieval evaluator against the pinned corpus and candidate configuration; assert checked-in recall@k/nDCG and latency/token thresholds for each required cohort and document type. Include ACL and deleted-document fixtures and fail if inaccessible or irrelevant chunks are returned.

nodes.title: RAG Citation Grounding
nodes.summary: Require material claims to resolve to authorized retrieved source spans and abstain or clarify when evidence is insufficient. Claim-level support checks make citations trustworthy.
nodes.probe: Parse every returned citation against retrieved chunk IDs and verify spans belong to the request's authorized context. Run supported, contradicted, uncited, and insufficient-evidence fixtures; assert claim-level thresholds, unresolved-citation rejection, and abstention/clarification for unsupported answers.

nodes.title: Fine-Tune Data Lineage
nodes.summary: Record immutable links from each training run to data, preprocessing, base model, parameters, safety filters, licensing, consent, hashes, and removals. Complete lineage enables reproduction and legally actionable deletion.
nodes.probe: Parse each fine-tune run manifest and verify immutable hashes and nonempty data, preprocessing, base model, parameters, tokenizer, license, consent, safety-filter, owner, and exclusion/removal fields. Alter a referenced input after manifest creation and confirm hash verification rejects the run.

nodes.title: Fine-Tune Evaluation Promotion
nodes.summary: Gate fine-tuned model promotion on holdout task and safety comparisons, canary health, approval, and tested rollback. This prevents overfit, memorized, or newly unsafe candidates replacing the baseline.
nodes.probe: Parse promotion workflow and reject a candidate lacking holdout evaluation, baseline comparison, safety report, canary result, approver, and rollback reference. In a staging harness inject a canary regression and assert rollout aborts and the previous model is restored.

nodes.title: Expensive Endpoint Rate Limit
nodes.summary: Apply authenticated weighted quotas, concurrency caps, burst handling, and abuse controls to expensive LLM operations. Rejected work must not reach the provider and noisy tenants must not monopolize capacity.
nodes.probe: With authenticated clients, exceed each per-user, per-tenant, weighted-token, burst, and concurrency limit; assert 429 plus valid Retry-After, bounded in-flight count, fair behavior for another tenant, and no upstream call after hard rejection. Confirm abuse fixtures trigger the documented friction without bypassing normal authorized traffic.

nodes.title: Tool Action Authorization
nodes.summary: Enforce least-privilege authorization, server-side argument validation, confirmation for destructive actions, and audit logging for model-invoked tools. Model output cannot grant its own permissions.
nodes.probe: Inspect the tool registry, scopes, schemas, and authorization middleware. Run fixtures for allowed read, cross-tenant read, malformed argument, destructive action, expired approval, and prompt-injected tool request; assert server-side denial/confirmation before execution and audit records for each decision.

nodes.title: Model Deprecation Inventory
nodes.summary: Maintain an owned inventory of deployed model/provider versions, lifecycle dates, capability/cost/latency baselines, replacements, and migration evaluations. Early warning avoids emergency untested migrations.
nodes.probe: Parse the inventory and compare it with deployed model IDs from configuration/telemetry; fail when any production model lacks owner, provider lifecycle status/date, compatible replacement, baseline, and migration-evaluation reference. Insert a near-sunset fixture and verify the alert/escalation path.

nodes.title: Structured Output Contract
nodes.summary: Define typed schemas, semantic invariants, explicit refusal or partial states, and bounded repair for model responses consumed by software. Validate server-side before parsing, tools, or actions.
nodes.probe: Send valid, malformed, refusal, truncated, extra-property, wrong-type, and semantically invalid fixtures. Assert schema validation and invariant checks, at most the configured repair count, no downstream action before success, and a safe typed error or explicit partial/refusal state when unrecoverable.
